about.title: Tustin Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Tustin sits where Orange County's commuter routes tighten. Northbound I-5 carries the heaviest share of the city's collision reports, and Red Hill Avenue, Newport Avenue, and Jamboree Road follow close behind. In 2025, the final public record listed 328 injury collisions, 441 people injured, and 5 traffic deaths. Wednesdays between 5 and 7 p.m. show the highest concentration of reports. A crash on any of these roads leaves you with more than a damaged car. Medical bills arrive before you feel steady, an adjuster calls sooner than you expect, and the paperwork multiplies. LawProactive exists for that moment. We are not a law firm. We are a free service that pairs Tustin residents with an independent personal injury attorney who handles cases on contingency, so nothing is owed unless there is a recovery. California gives most drivers two years to file, but claims against a public agency can carry a six-month deadline. Under the state's pure comparative fault rule, you may still recover even if you share part of the blame.

whyChoose.title: Why Tustin Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Deadlines Get Tracked Early
items.desc: California allows two years for most car accident claims, yet a crash involving a city or Caltrans vehicle can require notice within six months. The attorney you're matched with knows which clock is running.

items.title: Partial Fault Doesn't End Your Claim
items.desc: Under pure comparative fault, your recovery is reduced by your share of responsibility rather than erased. Even a driver who was partly at fault on Jamboree Road can still pursue compensation.

items.title: Evidence Stays Protected, Statements Stay Private
items.desc: Your attorney can secure dashcam footage, scene photos, and repair records before they disappear. Just as important, you won't need to give the other driver's insurer a recorded statement on your own.

items.question: The other driver's insurance company keeps calling me. Do I have to talk to them?
items.answer: You are not required to give a recorded statement to another driver's insurer, and it is usually wise not to. Adjusters ask questions designed to minimize what their company pays. Once you are connected with an attorney, those calls can be directed to them instead.

items.question: My crash happened on I-5 northbound near Tustin. Does that change anything?
items.answer: Freeway collisions are usually handled by CHP rather than Tustin police, so the report comes from a different agency and can take longer to obtain. If a state vehicle or roadway condition played a role, a government claim with a six-month notice window may also apply. An attorney can sort out which agencies and deadlines are involved.

items.question: I can't afford a lawyer right now. How does this work?
items.answer: LawProactive is free, and the independent attorneys in our network work on contingency. That means no upfront payment and no fee at all unless your case results in a recovery. The initial consultation costs nothing, so you can learn your options before committing to anything.
